name: HarborRank
tagline: Live SEO data for agents: keywords, SERPs, backlinks, audits, Search Console
description: Hosted SEO server for AI agents. Tools cover keyword metrics (volume, difficulty, intent, trends), live Google organic and local Maps results, a domain's ranking keywords and backlink overview, rank-tracker reads, crawl-based site audits, and read-only Google Search Console performance and URL inspection. Sign in with OAuth in the browser; no API key. Free plan with 1,000 credits a month; paid plans from $29 a month. Each research tool states its credit cost; Search Console tools use no credits.

install.notes: The first tool call opens a browser OAuth login. Create a free account at https://app.harborrank.com/sign-up if you do not have one.
